# Molar

> Molar is a beta browser automation and QA platform for web applications. Its QA offering focuses on customer flows that cross payments, authentication, messaging and other third-party services. Its general platform supports browser tasks for people and AI agents.

## Start here
- [AI QA for web apps](https://molar.it/): what Molar tests and an illustrative checkout walkthrough.
- [Browser automation platform](https://molar.it/platform): browser tasks, exploration and extraction.
- [Documentation](https://docs.molar.it): installation, configuration and current command references.
- [Create an account](https://app.molar.it/dashboard/signup)
- [Beta access and pricing](https://molar.it/pricing): availability and usage are scoped for each setup; this site does not publish fixed plan prices.

## Products
- [Cartographer](https://molar.it/products/cartographer): browser exploration, flow maps and Playwright export workflows.
- [Clones](https://molar.it/products/clones): stateful test services for supported payment, messaging, identity and storage behavior.
- [Guard](https://molar.it/products/guard): release checks and recurring test workflows.
- [Trace](https://molar.it/products/trace): browser evidence and failure investigation.
- [Mender](https://molar.it/products/mender): repair workflow in preview; availability must be confirmed.

## Resources
- [Guides](https://molar.it/blog)

## Reading the examples
The marketing demos use labeled illustrative data and do not execute a live test. Service coverage depends on the configured provider behavior, environment and credentials. A passing browser run does not by itself establish complete app coverage, portable generated-test replay or a verified repair. Product availability is beta; confirm the requirements for a specific workflow with Molar.
